test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Identify the correct adverb:

He finished the work_____ to avoid missing the deadline.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hurriedly**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**hurriedly**" is an adverb that describes the manner in which the action was performed.
 
• In the sentence, the action "finished the work" describes how it was done to meet a deadline. An adverb is required to modify the verb "finished."
 
• **Options 1, 2, and 3** are not adverbs and cannot correctly modify the verb in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He finished the work **hurriedly**__ to avoid missing the deadline."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "hurried"** is an adjective and cannot modify the verb "finished" in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "hurrying"** is the present participle form and does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3: "hurry"** is the base form of the verb and is incorrect here.
